name: Five-Second Rule
description: Complete five original micro-challenges by reading each fresh two-line instruction and acting through the visible task controls before its five-second opportunity closes. Use only screenshots and visible task-page controls; implementation and hidden-state access are forbidden.
natural_language: Complete the five original five-second dispatches. Read both lines of each fresh order, track the changing state, and carry out its click, hold, flick, pair, or drop action before the opportunity closes. Solve only from screenshots and visible task-page controls; do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, a terminal or shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.source_notes: The uniform short-task harness and explicit pass contract are grounded in the Kitboga Code Jam family and Mio-Micro's parsed two-line instructions plus formal win predicates. All shipped micro-challenge mechanics and visuals are original.
metadata.notes: Five shuffled five-second rounds replay direct or proxy input against generated moving geometry, synchronized cues, orientation sectors, relational targets, and timed shutters.
